The Petrochemicals Company is LG Chem's major business area with world-class productivity and cost competitiveness. We have established a vertically integrated system from basic raw materials such as ethylene and propylene to downstream products such as PE, ABS, and synthetic rubber. Advanced Materials Company We aim to become a global top‑tier battery and electronic materials company leading next‑generation technologies. Life Sciences Company We aim to rise as a global pharmaceutical company that develops innovative new drugs.
